propositions: Plan-review Pass 1 can serialize failed criteria as empty successes with checkpoints that omit policy, prompt, contract, and topology inputs, losing operational context.

The plan-review strategy adapter must compile Round-A discovery topology into DiscoveryStagePlan units from CriteriaSnapshot and execute through the S2 shared kernel while preserving existing YAML/BPMN graph, bounded concurrency, cache warming, and cancellation behavior.

Failed local units must not serialize as clean checkpoints; earlier successes survive, independent work continues, dependents skip, and the final verdict follows the approved BLOCK/INDETERMINATE/advisory-only PASS policy.

The new checkpoint key must change when any material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependency, or namespace input changes; corrupt and legacy entries produce zero reuse.
Only content-identical success/resume envelopes seed reuse; failed, cancelled, skipped, and budget-shed units remain missing and callable on later runs.
The reducer-ignored review journal stores the safe versioned trace; review-plan and review-plan --status outputs contain only their established end-result fields, with no per-unit trace exposed.
